text: 华东师范大学第四附属中学Hi boys and girls, 我是来自华东师范大学第四附属中学的陈嘉颖老师。Today, we are going to talk about how English plays a role in our daily lives.From the last period, we can know that English is widely used around the world.Do you use English in your daily life?What do you use English to do?Rose, what's your idea?I always use English in my daily life.I enjoy using English to read books and watch movies from other cultures.Yes, we use English in different ways.We use English to travel and ask for directions in foreign countries.We also use English to post our lives on social media.Now, open your books and turn to page 6.Please scan the text and think about the question.Where can we find moments?We can find moments on social media platforms.What's the meaning of moment?Guess its meaning and then take a look at its meaning in the dictionary entry.On social media platforms, moments are posts or updates where people share their experiences and thoughts.A moment can be defined as a time for doing something here.Now, please read this moment.Let's discuss the following questions.Who posted the moment?Yes, Yiming did.What was the moment about?Rose?Yiming had a nice weekend.Yiming had a nice weekend with his grandparents in the city center.Good.Did Yiming write his moment in British English or American English?Asher?It's in British English.Yes, that's right.Because the spelling of center is in British English.Good job.Let's list the places Yiming visited in the city center.They went to Shanghai Museum, Yu Garden and the Bund.What did they do there?They enjoyed an interesting exhibition in the museum.They had some traditional snacks at Yu Garden.They enjoyed beautiful night views along the Bund.The pictures in Yiming's post arouse readers' interest and also help us get the information.Do you think so?Yiming got a lot of likes and comments.Now, let's read the comments.How many friends gave Yiming's moment likes?Six friends gave Yiming's moment likes.Who gave Yiming comments?James, Lisa, John and David gave Yiming comments.Yiming's post was written in English.Yes, maybe he got some foreign friends.What were their comments about?Is the exhibition easy to understand?That's James' question.He is interested in the entertainment.Lisa wants to know what the steamed buns are called in Chinese.She is curious about the dining.Both John and David want to know about traveling in Shanghai.How did Yiming respond to these comments?What were his replies?Now, please take out your worksheets.Let's read Yiming's moment again and complete the table in your worksheets task one.Rose, would you please share your work with us?We can see that the exhibition in the museum is in both Chinese and English, and the tour guides speak fluent English.As to traveling, the signs and maps at the underground stations are written in both Chinese and English.The volunteers speak English as well.We can also see that the restaurant has English menus.Well done, Rose.But we usually say the exhibition at the museum.Please pay attention to the preposition here.What did Yiming mainly chat about with his friends in the comments?Asher, what's your idea?It shows that English is almost everywhere in Shanghai.Shanghai is a foreigner-friendly city.Great.Let's read the moment again and discuss the following questions.What other replies did Yiming give?Take it easy.Don't worry.Emoji as well.Excellent.Why did Yiming reply to his friends in these ways?Yiming's replies are thoughtful, right?They help to make his friends feel comfortable and less worried about being in a foreign country.Let's read what David commented under Yiming's post.Has Yiming replied to David yet?No, he hasn't.How would Yiming reply to David?Could you help Yiming reply to David?Now please take out your worksheet.Look at task 2.And think about what we need to pay attention to when replying to David.Well done, Asher.When you help Yiming reply to David, please remember1.Show wide use of English in Shanghai from different aspects, like public transportation, service.Use expressions to make David feel less worried.Now complete Yiming's reply in your worksheet.Good job, Asher!This is me.Asher, thank you!Thank you so much!Thank
